title: Harbor and Vow
author: Cyrus Brightwater
blurb: Kestrel Lockridge, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
